provider: Purdue University Archives and Special Collections
subject: John C. Smalley Center for Housing & Food Service Administration
historical_observations: The original women’s residence halls administration building was constructed north of Meredith Hall in 1963.
The building was added onto in 1982.
It was renamed the John C. Smalley Center for Housing & Food Service Administration in 1985.
geometry_limits: This archival record establishes identity and building-phase history only. It does not provide the 1982 addition footprint, facade elevations, roof form, or measured height.
